_meta: 8 tier-1 expansion cases authored 2026-06-17 (agent a14f724d), neutral mechanic-only blinded descriptions, winners verified from primary sources. PENDING independent adversarial valence audit before pre-registration. SCOPE NOTE: wikipedia_donor_count_framing is flagged for EXCLUSION from the scored set (sub-deliberative social-proof nudge, not a deliberative product change — out of the portfolio's in-scope class per the Hillstrom-certified boundary); retained here for the record / a future nudge-class probe.

cases.control: On a category listing page, each product shows one price: the most recently offered price for that product.
cases.treatment: On a category listing page, each product shows a price stated as a low-to-high range across the prices currently offered for that product.

reported_effect.value: +3.6% product click-throughs (+0.011 clicks/listing, p<0.001, n=2.48M views)

cases.control: The credit-card offer is shown in the top slot of the home page.
cases.treatment: The credit-card offer is shown on the shopping-cart page after an item is added, with arithmetic showing the amount relative to the items in the cart.

reported_effect.value: tens of millions annual profit; winning arm had LOWER CTR

cases.control: Clicking the mail link replaces the current page, navigating away from the home page in the same tab.
cases.treatment: Clicking the mail link opens the mail destination in a new tab, leaving the home page open in the original tab.
cases.metric: clicks per user on the home page (triggered users)

cases.control: The 'most common issues' box near the top of the page shows one list of answers that is the same for every visitor.
cases.treatment: The 'most common issues' box near the top of the page shows a list of answers selected for the visitor's detected browser and operating system.
cases.metric: click-through rate on the answers section

reported_effect.value: CTR over 50% higher for treatment (proof of concept)

cases.control: The signup page uses black text on a white background.
cases.treatment: The signup page uses white text on a black background.

cases.control: A profile-completion module prompts the member to add a volunteer-experience section.
cases.treatment: A profile-completion module prompts the member to add a volunteer-experience section and includes the line 'Add more color to your professional identity by showing what you care about.'

cases.control: Search results are shown in pages with page-number links; the user clicks to load the next page and the scroll position is kept when returning from a product page.
cases.treatment: Search results load automatically as the user scrolls, appending below the current results with no page links and no stored scroll position on returning from a product page.
cases.metric: search engagement (result clicks, items favorited, items purchased from search)

reported_effect.value: infinite scroll: fewer clicks/favorites/purchases-from-search; impressions 40 vs 80

cases.control: A donation banner states the daily view count and then says 'Already N people have donated so far.'
cases.treatment: A donation banner states the daily view count and then says 'but only N people have donated so far.'
cases.EXCLUSION_REASON: Sub-deliberative social-proof framing nudge, not a deliberative product change — out of the portfolio's in-scope class (cf. Hillstrom-certified nudge boundary). Held for a future nudge-class probe.
